messages:
Sam: Ran perfetto + nsys on the short-seq regression run, uploaded archive: gs://redwood-traces/1765432/prefetch-kernel-reg.zip :link:
Tara: quick scan — kernel_selector::choose_kernel is hot (~28-40% during short bursts). perfetto shows tight kernel timelines around prefetchs. :eyes:
Nate: agree. We only have coarse NVTX ranges right now so we can't tell if overhead is from kv cache misses or selector heuristics
Priya: Proposed NVTX layout (low-overhead, filterable):
  - Parent request range: "req:<model>:<ver>:<reqid>"
  - Child ranges: "req.prefetch", "req.kvcache.get/<shard>", "req.kernel.select", "req.kernel.launch"
Sam: Example helper macros (pseudo):
```
NVTX_PUSH_FMT("req.%s:%s", model_short, req_id);
NVTX_PUSH("req.kvcache.get");
// ... NVTX_POP() when done
```
Tara: Add NVTX payload keys: batch_size, seq_len, model, sample_id. Perfetto lets us filter by payload which is way easier than parsing names.
Nate: Concern: per-request ranges at production QPS will explode trace size. We should sample (1% default) or make the parent range only for sampled requests.
perf-bot: tracing-config updated: nightly sampling -> 0.5%, debug runs 100%. :robot_face:
Priya: For kernel naming: don't use raw ptrs. Use stable short keys: "kern:<op>:<dtype>:<impl_hash>". Also push kernel key as NVTX id so we can map timeline -> kernel binary later.
Sam: Repro note: when kv_cache miss rate >12% we see kernel-selector fallback hitting extra code paths, adding ~5-7% p99. Repro command:
```
python -m perf.run --scenario=short-batched --seq=40 --batch=8 --trace nsys --out trace.ns
```
Tara: Next steps: 1) add NVTX payload fields + stable kernel keys, 2) NVTX helpers + sampling toggle in runtime config, 3) run canary with tracing enabled for sampled traffic, collect perfetto/nsys for 48h.
Nate: I'll draft the NVTX helper PR (small API, zero-cost when disabled) and include a switch: RUNTIME_TRACE_SAMPLING_RATE.
Priya: I'll update the kernel selector to emit the small key/hash and ensure kvcache prefetch points get ranges. Also add a compact counter to metric stream showing prefetch miss-rate.
Sam: :thumbsup: Thanks — let's mark owner tags and we'll sync in tomorrow sync. If someone wants to pair on the nsys script I have the trace filtering pipeline (perfetto -> flamegraph json).
